title: Counterfactual grader looks PAST the exit: extend every graded package's price path after the close (until each alt arm resolves, capped at the leg's own max-hold or a stated horizon) and add a post-exit block (MFE/MAE after exit in R, did price later reach the original TP, would SL x1.25/1.5 have survived and to what net R, 'exited early' vs 'exit saved R'), so every trade review answers both 'should we have exited sooner' and 'did we exit too early'
note: Operator 2026-10-29 ~19:05Z, verbatim: "when we are reviewing trades, we are not only reviewing till when the trade ended, but also after, so that we know if we are exiting too early, which is also a possibility." Example: XRP pkg-5d74ca7451d64ebe stopped at -1R after reviews advised close; would a wider stop have turned it into a winner? Measured gap: comms/research/counterfactual_grades/pkg-465a5d7d27644027.json path last_bar 11:14Z vs t_close 10:51Z (23 min of post-exit data), so alt arms that hold longer are marked unresolved at the last bar. Extends TRADE-COUNTERFACTUAL-GRADER (#21256, scripts/research/counterfactual_grader.py); feeds RULE-AM-RISK-ADJUSTED-V1 and /performance-review.  PR #21386 (draft): post_exit block + horizon landed in the grader; XRP pkg-5d74ca7451d64ebe not answerable until 2026-10-31T18:33Z (1.25x/3R arm stopped at -1.06R in the 37 min observed; 1.5x unresolved).
